text: Could you make a simple illustration of a desk viewed from above? I've had this little desk scene in mind for a while and finally wanted to see it as an image. What I mean is an open laptop in the middle, with a yellow cup to its left and a closed blue notebook to its right, in a wide 16:9 image. I tend to overthink how these little arrangements will look once they're drawn. Please leave space between the three objects. There shouldn't be any text.
